events.text:
I couldn't make the square image. Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and nothing was charged.

I'd tried the cheapest free-plan image editor at its free 640px size. The request asked for a square frame with the whole shoe in the middle and no centre crop, plain padding matching the background where needed, and no other changes.

**A note on your worry about losing part of the shoe:** These tools edit images with AI. That means they redraw the picture rather than just cropping and padding it. Even when told to change nothing, they can slightly alter the shoe or the background, and the output is limited to 640×640 px on the free plan. Since you want no edits beyond the framing, a plain crop and pad in a basic editor would protect the shoe better. Most phone photo apps, Canva, Photopea or Preview on a Mac can do it:

1. Crop to just the photo, removing the empty grey strip on the right. That leaves about 640 × 384 px.
2. Make the canvas square at 640 × 640 px, keeping the photo in the middle so the shoe stays whole.
3. Fill the added space above and below with the grey of the floor or wall. You could also pick a plain white or light grey, which looks clean on a shop page.

If you'd still like me to do it here, top up your Magic Hour credits and I'll run it, then send you the download link. Please check the shoe closely before you put the image in your shop.

events.why: The reply says the edit failed because the account lacks credits, so nothing was made. It suggests doing it manually and offers to retry only after the user tops up. That is a plan or credit limitation, not a request for approval.
